changelog.title: Vox 2.0.7 — the frontend, rebuilt
items: Not a reskin. The palette, the type scale, the corners, the motion family and the
onboarding flow were replaced, and every screen inherits from them.

changelog.title: A new surface
items: Ink canvas `#09090B` with a 12% hairline grid, replacing the warm brown-black and its glass edges.
One accent: Signal vermilion `#FF5C38`, used for play, progress, selection and section marks — nothing else.
Every squircle is gone. 82 files moved from continuous 20dp curves to print-cut corners (4dp artwork, 8dp cards, 12dp sheets).
Drop shadows removed from covers and cards. A cover is a plate on the page, not a floating tile.
Light mode is paper stock `#F5F1E8` with ink type, not an iOS grey system background.

changelog.title: A new voice
items: Headlines run on Chillax at display sizes with trackings tightened by hand; body copy stays on your chosen reading face.
The Material and iOS type scales were both rebuilt from the same numbers, so a screen that never left the compat layer still lands on the new hierarchy.
Micro-labels are 10sp, uppercase, 1.9 tracking. Section headers now close with a hairline rule instead of a floating pill and a champagne tick.

changelog.title: Onboarding, rewritten
items: Four pages set like a magazine: folio counter, eyebrow, a display headline with the signal word in vermilion, a hairline-divided list, one filled bar.
Pastel app-icon tiles are gone; glyphs are monochrome inside hairline squares.
Progress is four hairlines, not dots. Page transitions slide and crossfade with a spring, and the primary button is a rectangular signal bar.
The Vox seal rotates once every 32 seconds as a registration mark, not a spinner.

changelog.title: Motion
items: One spring family for surfaces (`settle`, 0.92/340), one for touch (`snap`, 0.82/640), expo-out for arrivals, 180ms for exits, 28ms stagger.
Page pushes now settle on a spring instead of a fixed 260ms tween, so interrupting a push keeps its velocity.
The tab fold and mini-player flight keep the 380/0.85 spring.

changelog.title: Notes
items: Signed release build, `com.vox.music`, arm64-v8a + x86_64. Not a debug build.
Still to come: the remaining library, settings and player screens are on the new tokens but have not had their individual layouts redrawn yet.
